newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean 3-yr yields close flat after early drop.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean 3-yr yields close flat after early drop.

text.p: Benchmark three-year corporate bond yields closed flat on Thursday as early falls were offset by mounting selling pressure towards the close, brokers said.
They said selling increased as traders expected yields to rise on Friday due to heavy new issues. Friday's new issues were estimated at 188.4 billion won versus 21.4 billion today.
"Trading was slow today in the belief that yields would rise tomorrow," said a Samsung Securities broker.
The short-term liquidity remained ample, pushing lower the three-month CD yields and the overnight call rate.
